scripts.dev:
echo '
🚀 Starting development servers...
' && concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c blue,green "cd frontend && pnpm run dev" "cd backend && pnpm start"
scripts.links:
echo '
🔗 DEVELOPMENT SERVERS:
📱 Frontend: http://localhost:3000
⚙️  Backend: http://localhost:5001
'
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c blue,green "cd frontend && pnpm run start" "cd backend && pnpm run start"
scripts.test: pnpm run test:frontend && pnpm run test:backend
scripts.test:frontend: cd frontend && pnpm exec vitest run
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && pnpm exec vitest run
scripts.typecheck: cd frontend && pnpm run prisma:generate && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run check:content-images && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
